english.title: Use / cause / permit vehicle to be used with defective fuel / exhaust system at Southampton Airport
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..)

(A)_[used a vehicle, namely **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..),]_
(B)_[caused a vehicle, namely **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..), to be used]_
(C)_[permitted a vehicle, namely **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..), to be used]_

at **(..SPECIFY THE LOCATION..) at Southampton Airport when the condition of the

(D)_[fuel]_
(E)_[exhaust]_

system was not at all times such that no danger or nuisance was caused or was likely to be caused to a person or property
english.legislation: Contrary to byelaws 5(7) and 2(2) of the Southampton International Airport Byelaws, 1996 and sections 63 and 64 of the Airports Act 1986.
english.pointstoprove:
Date and Location
use / cause / permit vehicle to be used
when the condition of the fuel / exhaust system
was not at all times such that no danger / nuisance was
caused / was likely to be caused to a person / property

investigatoraction.description: Guilty Plea by letter procedure may be offered for this offence
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes: The act in this Byelaw is prohibited on any part of the Airport to which the road traffic enactments do not apply.
